findings.title: AntiSandwichMock (src/mocks/general/AntiSandwichMock.sol#15-50) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2)
findings.description: AntiSandwichMock (src/mocks/general/AntiSandwichMock.sol#15-50) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.
evidence: AntiSandwichMock (src/mocks/general/AntiSandwichMock.sol#15-50) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.
